about: The falsifier: between births a published place was reborn only by a script beside the instrument, obligations/rebirth.sh gate, and a place without one had no gate at all. The script took 65 s over obligations at epoch 271, and 205 s at 255; verify, a published place with a release of its own, had no rebirth gate while it waited for one.

cases.name: obligations/rebirth.sh gate over the tree, epoch 271
